You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a fridge. What a letdown! The fridge is empty! You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see an oven. Oh, great. Here's a table. The table is massive. On the table you make out a cookbook. Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a counter. On the counter you make out a red onion and an orange bell pepper. You make out a stove. Why don't you take a picture of it, it'll last longer! The stove is conventional. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?

There is an open screen door leading east. There is a closed plain door leading north. There is an exit to the west.

There is a diced fried red potato, a yellow bell pepper, a raw purple potato, a carrot and a raw yellow potato on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a knife, a fried red hot pepper, a sliced grilled banana, a sliced roasted white onion and a diced roasted pork chop.
